as_told.title: Friend in charge of technology transfer from a group of ETs

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has a friend who was in charge of technology transfer with one group of aliens, meaning the passing of their know-how to humans. Buchanan relays what this friend told him about it, and the story's framing ties it to a craft driven by magnets, though in one retelling he mentions only the friend's role and not the magnets. If true, it would mean people have been learning engineering directly from beings from elsewhere.
